name: Mythic Leadership (Mythic)
source: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats
book: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

facets.bk: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

body:
Even those who follow you are mythic.

Prerequisites: Leadership, character level 7, 2nd mythic tier.

Benefit(s): Add your mythic tier to your leadership score.

The cohort you gain from the Leadership feat is a mythic character with a mythic tier equal to 1/2 your own mythic tier. Additionally if your cohort dies you may replace him in 24 hours by calling on the source of your mythic power. However, doing so causes you to have 1 fewer uses of mythic power per day for the next 30 days. If you are of the 5th or greater mythic tier, your 10 highest level followers are also 1st mythic tier.
